name: ttyglass
description: Observe and debug real terminal user interfaces in a local browser.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs && nub --filter @ttyglass/frontend run build && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.check: nub --filter @ttyglass/frontend run check && biome check src test tests scripts && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.format: nub --filter @ttyglass/frontend run format && biome format --write src test tests scripts
